test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I need to _______ my shoelaces before going out.
solution:
The correct answer is '**tie**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**tie**" means to fasten something, such as shoelaces, using a knot.
 
• The other options are incorrect: 
 
 
• **Tye** is a misspelling of "tie."
 
• **Thai** refers to the culture, language, or people of Thailand, which is unrelated to the context.
 
• **Thigh** refers to the upper part of the human leg, unrelated to tying shoelaces.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"I need to **tie** my shoelaces before going out."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Tie" is the correct verb for fastening shoelaces or ropes with a knot or bow.
 
• Other options are irrelevant or incorrect spellings in this context.
